_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sizing the delivery in Delivery Units…

description: Estimate the size and cost of a specific list of work items. Given short descriptions of deliverables, this returns each item sized in Delivery Units, a total, an indicative cost, and a recommended plan size. Use this tool when the user has already broken the work into specific items and wants sizing. When the user describes an overall goal without a breakdown, use create_delivery_plan instead.

company_size.description: Optional company-size hint: startup, small, medium, enterprise.

modules.description: List of work modules to estimate. Each item is a 1-2 sentence description of a deliverable, e.g. 'Tenant onboarding flow with SSO integration' or 'Migrate 200 SAP custom reports to Power BI'.

name: estimate_delivery_cost

outputSchema.description: Per-module Delivery Unit sizing + total project cost + recommended pack.

aus.description: Delivery Units for this module (legacy JSON key: aus).

recommended_pack.description: The recommended Delivery Pack tier for this plan.

delivery_units.description: Delivery Units in the pack (0 for enterprise/custom).
